linkbit_epd_init.tooltip: Initialize the onboard 2.13" 104×212 four-grey e-paper (fixed pins CS=2 DC=3 RST=1 BUSY=0 SCK=6 MOSI=7); the canvas starts white, text black

linkbit_epd_set_rotation.tooltip: Canvas orientation: portrait 104×212, landscape 212×104. Affects later drawing only

linkbit_epd_clear_ghosting.tooltip: Wipe ghosting with alternating full black and white refreshes; each round is two full refreshes (over ten seconds). The panel ends white, the canvas is kept

linkbit_epd_frame.tooltip: Prepare the canvas as selected, run the drawing blocks inside, then do one full refresh (several seconds)

linkbit_epd_display.tooltip: Push the canvas to the e-paper. Drawing blocks only change the canvas; a refresh takes several seconds

linkbit_epd_clear.tooltip: Fill the canvas with one color and refresh immediately

linkbit_epd_fill_screen.tooltip: Fill the whole canvas with one color (no refresh)

linkbit_epd_draw_pixel.tooltip: Draw one pixel on the canvas; anything off screen is clipped

linkbit_epd_draw_line.message0: e-paper %1 line X1 %2 Y1 %3 X2 %4 Y2 %5 color %6
linkbit_epd_draw_line.tooltip: Draw a straight line on the canvas

linkbit_epd_draw_rect.message0: e-paper %1 rectangle X %2 Y %3 width %4 height %5 color %6 %7
linkbit_epd_draw_rect.tooltip: Draw a rectangle from its top-left corner (X, Y), outline or filled

linkbit_epd_draw_circle.message0: e-paper %1 circle center X %2 Y %3 radius %4 color %5 %6
linkbit_epd_draw_circle.tooltip: Draw a circle centered at (X, Y), outline or filled

linkbit_epd_set_text_color.tooltip: Color of Latin text and digits, transparent background

linkbit_epd_set_text_size.tooltip: Scale Latin text and digits by a whole number

linkbit_epd_set_font.tooltip: Font for Latin text and digits. The default font is placed by its top-left corner, the others by the text baseline

linkbit_epd_set_cursor.tooltip: Start point of the next Latin text

linkbit_epd_print.tooltip: Write Latin text, digits or a variable at the cursor (use the Chinese text block for Chinese)

linkbit_epd_cn_text.message0: e-paper %1 at X %2 Y %3 show Chinese text %4 font %5 color %6
linkbit_epd_cn_text.tooltip: Show mixed Chinese and Latin UTF-8 text; (X, Y) is the bottom-left baseline, background transparent. Large digits contain only digits and : - . /

linkbit_epd_draw_weather.message0: e-paper %1 at X %2 Y %3 draw weather icon %4 color %5
linkbit_epd_draw_weather.tooltip: Draw a 32×32 weather icon from its top-left corner (X, Y); lines only, background transparent

linkbit_epd_draw_image.message0: e-paper %1 at X %2 Y %3 draw image %4 color %5
linkbit_epd_draw_image.tooltip: Draw the lit pixels of the image in the given color; other pixels keep the canvas as it is

linkbit_epd_image_portrait.tooltip: Full-screen portrait monochrome image; draw it or import a picture

linkbit_epd_image_landscape.tooltip: Full-screen landscape monochrome image, use with landscape orientation

linkbit_epd_width.tooltip: Canvas width in the current orientation (portrait 104, landscape 212)

linkbit_epd_height.tooltip: Canvas height in the current orientation (portrait 212, landscape 104)

linkbit_epd_color.tooltip: One of the four grey levels of the e-paper
